unresolvedProvenance.name: native-promise-only
unresolvedProvenance.issue: No immutable historical full license file is published in the exact package or its registry gitHead. The original source directly references the author MIT endpoint; exact current full text from that endpoint is staged, with original versioned copyright header retained. Its dynamic2026 year is not represented as a historical0.8.1 copyright year.
unresolvedProvenance.impact: If the integration acceptance requires a contemporaneous immutable full license snapshot rather than the exact originally linked author license, this evidence requirement remains unresolved; no historical text was fabricated.

redistributionAssessment: No legal certification. No new noncommercial-only text was observed in retrieved notice files. Named prior missing full texts are supplied, subject to the native-promise historical-source caveat. Original font, dual-license and other conditions in the base manifest remain unchanged. No assertion that all possible hidden Plotly prebundle dependencies have been exhaustively audited.
collectionMethod: Downloaded exact npm package source tarballs only, no install or third-party code execution. Selected actual notice members were extracted with tar and copied verbatim. Linked author plain-text license retrieved with curl. New notices concatenate onto entire original collection using binary copy, with separate provenance headers. No repository code/docs/browser/providers/build/test changes.
